tasks.label: build
tasks.detail: Restore (incl. packages.config) and build textr.sln with Visual Studio's MSBuild, located via vswhere
args: $vswhere = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath('ProgramFilesX86')) 'Microsoft Visual Studio\Installer\vswhere.exe'; $msbuild = & $vswhere -latest -prerelease -products * -requires Microsoft.Component.MSBuild -find 'MSBuild\**\Bin\MSBuild.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $msbuild) { Write-Error 'MSBuild not found (Visual Studio or Build Tools required)'; exit 1 }; & $msbuild textr.sln -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true -p:Configuration=Debug -v:minimal -nologo; exit $LASTEXITCODE
